typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Commentary as string,
		{Call (USDE)} as string,
		{Remaining Call} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		Client as string,
		{REG Type} as string,
		{Partial Settlement} as string,
		Age as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Commentary as string,
		Call__USDE_ as string,
		Remaining_Call as string,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Title__Title_ as string,
		Client as string,
		REG_Type as string,
		Partial_Settlement as string,
		Age as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 5000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Commentary,
		Call__USDE_ = {Call (USDE)},
		Remaining_Call = {Remaining Call},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		Client,
		REG_Type = {REG Type},
		Partial_Settlement = {Partial Settlement},
		Age),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
